description: Characterful family home on 3 levels, very quiet, in the Lycée Michelet neighborhood. Widely open from the living room on a 150m² garden, it will allow you to fully enjoy the beautiful seasonImmediate proximity to Vanves shops and restaurants. Access to Espace Arena Sud (10 min walk) and transport to the Olympic sites of Paris/Saint Denis by Bus 58 (2min) Bus 89 (5min) Metro L13 (10 min) L12 (15 min)Comfortable, 3 bedrooms (6 people), garden and private parking 5 min walkThe spaceYou’ll love the calm and comfort of this house, which is filled with works of art by its owner, and you’ll enjoy its garden and terrace after your days of exploring. In the garden, you can enjoy your meals at the large outdoor table and savor the delights of the barbecue (charcoal provided) on long summer evenings, by the light of the lanterns. Everyone will find their account between the armchairs and the coffee table for extended aperitifs, the hammock to read or rest and the ping pong table for the more sporty.Inside the house, you will find a piano, a bookcase, a foosball table, a Bluetooth/Wi-Fi sound system, and a smart TV with a Blu-ray DVD player at your disposal. On the ground floor, the living room welcomes you with its wide relaxation area, completely open to the garden, and the dining room for 6 people. The independent kitchen is fully equipped (induction hob, oven, microwave, fridge with freezer, dishwasher, Nespresso machine, toaster, kettle etc.). You have access to a bathroom with toilet, washing machine, and a closet.On the upper level: 2 large bedrooms with air conditioning upstairs.
